errors.text_span: wobei die Kategorien horizontal angeordnet sind
errors.evidence: This phrasing is ambiguous and potentially incorrect. The bars are horizontal, but the categories ('eher verringert', 'nicht verändert', 'eher erhöht') are listed vertically along the y-axis.
The chart displays grouped bars, not stacked bars. For each category on the y-axis, the three bars are shown side-by-side, not stacked on top of one another.
